title: MITRE SHIELD Schema v1.0
description: JSON Schema for MITRE SHIELD active defense framework. SHIELD defines defensive tactics, techniques, opportunities, use cases, and procedures for active defense operations against adversaries.

tactic.title: SHIELD Defensive Tactic
tactic.description: High-level defensive tactic that organizes related techniques. SHIELD defines 8 core tactics.

id.description: Unique SHIELD tactic identifier in format DTA#### (e.g., DTA0001-DTA0008)

name.description: Tactic name - fixed set of 8 core SHIELD tactics

description.description: Short description of the tactic (1-2 sentences)

long_description.description: Detailed description with strategic context and rationale

technique_ids.description: Technique IDs (DTE####) that support this tactic. Minimum 1 required.

technique.title: SHIELD Defensive Technique
technique.description: Defensive technique that implements specific defensive actions or deceptions.

id.description: Unique SHIELD technique identifier in format DTE#### (e.g., DTE0001, DTE0036+)

opportunity_ids.description: Opportunity IDs (DOS####) where this technique applies. Optional.

tactics.description: Tactic IDs (DTA####) that employ this technique. Back-reference for querying.

opportunity.title: SHIELD Opportunity
opportunity.description: Strategic defensive opportunity for applying techniques against adversary behavior.

id.description: Unique SHIELD opportunity identifier in format DOS#### (e.g., DOS0001-DOS0253+)

description.description: Description of the defensive opportunity and context where it applies

use_case_ids.description: Use case IDs (DUC####) that implement this opportunity. CRITICAL: Minimum 1 required.

technique_ids.description: Technique IDs (DTE####) that enable this opportunity. Back-reference for querying.

useCase.title: SHIELD Use Case
useCase.description: Practical implementation scenario demonstrating how to apply techniques and opportunities.

id.description: Unique SHIELD use case identifier in format DUC#### (e.g., DUC0001-DUC0261+)

description.description: Practical implementation scenario or concrete example

procedure_ids.description: Procedure IDs (DPR####) that implement this use case. Optional.

opportunity_id.description: Parent opportunity ID (DOS####). Back-reference for querying.

procedure.title: SHIELD Procedure
procedure.description: Executable technical procedure or detailed implementation step.

id.description: Unique SHIELD procedure identifier in format DPR#### (e.g., DPR0001-DPR0066+)

description.description: Detailed technical procedure or implementation steps

attackMapping.title: SHIELD to ATT&CK Mapping
attackMapping.description: Cross-reference linking SHIELD defensive entities to MITRE ATT&CK offensive techniques and tactics.

shieldId.description: SHIELD entity identifier (any type: DTA, DTE, DOS, DUC, DPR)

shieldType.description: Type of SHIELD entity for type discrimination

attackId.description: ATT&CK technique ID (e.g., T1039, T1021.002 with optional subtechnique)

relationshipType.description: Type of relationship between SHIELD and ATT&CK: detects (detects technique), mitigates (reduces impact), enables (allows controlled execution), tests (probes capability), engages_with (active engagement)

coverage.description: Coverage level of defensive capability against this technique
